## Description

Add an integration test in ~/adaptive-artifacts that runs the real CLI watch --interval 0.2 in a pty against a temp store. It asserts the first frame, a redraw showing a new record within 3 s of a CLI write, no redraw frames over an idle second, and exit 0 on SIGINT. Then run both full suites. Waits for terminal-view-format and watch-command.
record.subject: verify-watch-renderer-phase
